bm.api.{get,post,patch,delete}           - raw escape hatch, auto-CSRF + auto-JSON. A failed call throws an Error whose message is the server's explanation (`message`, else `error`), with err.code (the `error` code, e.g. 'forbidden', 'flow_no_response'), err.status and err.body; bm.flows, bm.auth, bm.table and bm.upload throw the same shape. A failed answer that is not JSON (an HTML error page, plain text) reads {error, body}: the message is the text when it is one short line of plain text, else 'Request failed (HTTP <status>)', and err.body.body holds the text

bm.auth.{me, signIn, signUp, signOut, refreshMe}  - session lifecycle. me().roles holds global and tenant roles; the generated Role type lists every role the config names (app.yaml roles:, groups.bootstrap.founding_role, access role:/owner_or_role:, workflow and flow role:) and, with groups.role_field set, also admits any string. In a groups: app me().group_id is the caller's current tenant (the groups.key value every scoped read uses; an admin's act-as tenant while stepped in), null before joining or founding one - the onboarding check. When the sign-in or sign-up still needs a step (the emailed or texted code with auth.otp, an authenticator code with MFA, enrolling an authenticator for a role in auth.require_mfa_for_roles), signIn, signUp and passkey.signIn send the browser to that page (same-origin only, keeping the page's ?next=) and do not resolve; the app serves those pages (api(at:"auth") step_pages), so code after the await does not run.
bm.users.{list, get}                     - public user-lookup (default-private; access: config gates)
bm.table(name).{list, get, create, update, delete}  - strongly typed; bm.table('typo') is a type error in your editor or tsc (push and esbuild don't type-check)

bm.table(...).list(opts)                 - opts: limit, offset, cursor, q, sort, order, where: {col: v, col__gte: v}, and the REST names orderBy: 'col:desc', include: 'rel' | ['a','b'], fields, page, per_page. It returns the rows only (use bm.api.get for the ?page= envelope's total). Any other top-level key is not sent and logs a console warning once (a filter belongs under where:).
bm.table(...).restore(id)                - only on tables with `deleted_at`
bm.table(...).list({q})                  - only on `@@fulltext` tables
bm.table(...).{versions, revertTo}       - only on versioned tables
bm.live(table, cb)                       - SSE, named-event aware (`addEventListener('change')` + onmessage)
bm.room(name)                            - WS room broadcast (chat / presence / peer-mesh signaling)
bm.broadcast.{publish, subscribe, stats}  - SFU livestream; the returned publisher/subscription has .stop(). The right primitive for any 1:N stream
bm.webrtc.iceServers()                   - STUN + TURN list for hand-rolled RTCPeerConnection

bm.flows.<name>(params, body)            - typed per HTTP flow from flows.yaml; a GET/HEAD flow takes params only (path segments, then the query string). Resolves parsed JSON, the text of a text/* answer, or a Blob for a binary one (api({at:'sdk'}) → response_bodies)

bm.workflow(table, id).{transitionTo, available, current}  - state machine. available() → { current, transitions: [{ to, role? }] }; transitionTo(to) → { status: 'transitioned', from, to, id } (id is a string); current() → the state in the workflow's own field. The generated types match these shapes.
bm.aggregate(name)  /  bm.aggregates.all()  - materialized aggregates (admin only)
bm.jobs.{status, wait}                   - async-flow job polling
bm.notifications.{list, markRead, markAllRead, delete, onNew}  - in-app inbox
bm.upload(file, opts)                    - multipart upload
bm.audit.list(filter)                    - admin audit log
bm.permissions.{share, revoke, list}     - per-row ACLs

bm.signedUrl(path, opts)                 - time-limited URLs; opts = { ttlSeconds?, record: { table, id } } (record required for private CDN files) or a bare TTL number; default 300s (see api({at:'signed-urls'}))
bm.t(key, vars)                          - i18n (keys typed against i18n/*.yaml)
bm.mfa.{enroll, verify, disable}         - TOTP enrollment + verification

bm.table.before(kind, fn)                - read/write interceptor. kind='read' fires for list/get/count, 'write' for create/update/delete. fn(opts, ctx) where ctx={table, op}; runs in registration order, each return feeds the next, returns an unsubscribe. The canonical multi-tenant scope-injection hook (e.g. inject where[group_id] on every query) - lets you stay on the typed client instead of hand-rolling apiList().

bm.html`
  • ${x}
    • ` / bm.raw(safe) - XSS-safe tagged template. Interpolated values are auto-escaped (text AND attributes), and a value that starts a URL attribute (href, src, action, formaction, xlink:href, poster, data, cite) with javascript:, vbscript: or a non-image data: URL becomes `#blocked-unsafe-url`, the rule server-rendered pages use; wrap an already-safe string in bm.raw(...) to opt out per-value; nested bm.html`…` and arrays of it are not double-escaped. Use instead of innerHTML + hand-rolled escapeHtml().
